profile.headline: Jr. Software Dev seeking work
profile.summary:
Programmer with a well rounded education. Focused on Java, SQL, C#, database and security. Experienced in C++, Python, Xamarin, design and development techniques. 
I bring a huge range of talents with me. From a deep knowledge of restaurant operations, logistics, sales, management and leadership.

positions.title: Sales
positions.description: Sale, from meet and greet to post sale follow ups. Including demo and drive, negotiation and all customer service oriented follow up.

positions.title: Owner Operator
positions.description: Part owner and in charge of all operations. Active in all creation and planning from concept to licensing, to equipment purchase and installation and opening.

positions.title: Assistant manager
positions.description: I was an assistant manager who was moved to three different stores to reorganize, re staff and completely overhaul operations and organization of troubled and failing stores.
